verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only that an 'n8n API' docs page exists, which is a bare title. It contains nothing describing an interactive API reference, a try-it console or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. An interactive API reference is a fair axis for a workflow-automation platform with a public API, so the absence of evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
